lines.text: No kidding, it rained all week.

data.define: Used to show surprise or say "obviously".

example.text: No kidding, it rained all week.

misuse.text: Don't say 'no kidding' to your teacher's lesson.

publish.title: What does "no kidding" mean?
publish.value: No kidding = Really? That's surprising. Example: "No kidding, it rained all week." (casual English, US).
